title: 5 signs you're a "one more video" person
format: Notes listicle, app on one point
why: Variant of 52 (1K views): same self-diagnosis listicle, new angle; app is the fix on the last sign.
caption: be honest, how many "one mores" last night? #doomscrolling #screentime
check: closer: 'way too many'. Only if true for you

slides.title: 5 signs you're a "one more video" person

slides.heading: _"one more"_ is never one
slides.text:
the feed knows the next one is better

that's _its whole job_

slides.heading: you can't remember _a single one_
slides.text:
if someone asked what you watched

you'd say _"stuff"_

slides.heading: lights off... _screen back on_
slides.top: you put it down. 30 seconds. _you pick it up again_
slides.text: the ending never feels like _the end_

slides.heading: you need _a hard stop_, not a better feed
slides.top: no feed will ever say _"that's enough"_
slides.text:
so when i'm stuck i put my apps _to sleep early_

one hold and they're _gone_ for as long as i pick

slides.question: how many "one mores" did you do last night? 👇
lines: the app is locturne, it's on the App Store
